lessons_used: No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test produced a statistically significant win.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) harms performance, with 3 tests agreeing after noise correction (-3.7% overall).
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) harms performance, with 2 tests agreeing after noise correction (-2.4% overall).
New adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) harm performance, with 2 tests agreeing after noise correction (-1.8% overall).
Evidence is thin or shows no clear effect for new home flows, adoption redesigns, path selection redesigns, and finish redesigns.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to measured results.

candidates.title: Choose Path Grid Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the path options section on the choose_path screen into a clean grid layout with distinct choice cards for each pet selection path.
candidates.why: Choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate and high mean duration of 514s, indicating decision fatigue with the current selection layout.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Choose Path Quick Selection Tip
candidates.change: Add a quick hint below the story screen header reassuring users that their path choice can be changed later anytime.
candidates.why: Mean time on choose_path step is 514s (vs 8s median), showing users get stuck hesitating over their initial choice.

story.hint: Don't worry, you can always adopt additional pets or change paths later in settings.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful hint to the story screen without violating onboarding copy rules.

candidates.score_note: High mean hesitation time, but lacks support email corroboration.

candidates.title: Sign In Simplified Centered Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the sign_in screen to use a centered layout with prominent sign-in options and clear account safety messaging.
candidates.why: Sign_in drops conversion to 72.9% and support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in with wrong accounts.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Companion

guard.reason: replacement for 'sign_in.sign_in_options' does not do the job (a sign-in button that says so): needs 1 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Background Notification
candidates.change: Enable a system notification on the waiting screen to alert users when their desktop pet finished generating while minimized.
candidates.why: Waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, and support reported 3 cases of pets not appearing when users switch away.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Adds a desktop notification setting to the waiting screen within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support and funnel, but requires native OS integration and release.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Tip Carousel
candidates.change: Add an auto-rotating tip carousel component to the waiting screen sharing basic tips on pet controls and desktop behavior.
candidates.why: Home waiting step takes median 201s/mean 2336s, and support gets 3 emails about desktop pet controls being unclear after onboarding.

components.text: Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick controls and settings.

guard.reason: Adds a tip carousel to the waiting screen without introducing false urgency or modifying pricing.

candidates.score_note: Clear evidence, but adding new UI components historically yields neutral or negative results.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Selection Reward Incentive
candidates.change: Display a clear badge component highlighting complimentary companion starter items upon picking a pet friend.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low at 60.9% with a mean duration of 1017s, indicating users need extra motivation during pet selection.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions free extras or starter items ('Includes Starter Accessory Pack'), which violates the rule against mentioning gifts or extras.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Friendly Guidance Header
candidates.change: Update headline and body on the upload_photos screen to clearly explain photo quality needs and prevent generation errors.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails regarding custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion drops to 60.9%.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Use well-lit photos showing your pet's face clearly for the best desktop pet creation result.
upload_photos.hint: Front-facing photos with clear lighting work best.

guard.reason: Updates guidance copy on the photo upload screen without removing required functionality.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest drop step with strong support evidence via low-risk copy tweak.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Full Bleed Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a full bleed layout with an interactive pet preview component.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops significantly to 60.9% and takes over 1000s on average, needing a more engaging certificate view.

guard.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate components to only include a preview removes the official stamp required for the adoption certificate screen.

candidates.title: Choose Path Guided Intro New Screen
candidates.change: Add a new introductory screen before choose_path to explain how desktop pets live on the user's screen.
candidates.why: Choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s, showing users lack initial context about desktop pets.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_path_intro']

candidates.title: Home Intro Pet Desktop Visibility Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint text on home_intro explaining how to summon or show the pet if it hides off-screen.
candidates.why: Finish conversion is 64.8% and support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on desktop or being hard to control.

home_intro.hint: If your pet wanders off-screen, click the system tray icon to recall it immediately.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful visibility hint to home_intro without modifying elements outside of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High impact step and strong evidence, though finish step changes historically perform poorly.

held_by_harm_budget: Home Intro Pet Desktop Visibility Hint
lessons_next: No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test produced a statistically significant win.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) harms performance, with 3 tests agreeing (-3.7% after noise correction).
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) harms performance, with 2 tests agreeing (-2.4% after noise correction).
No clear effect was seen for new adoption flows, adoption redesigns, path selection redesigns, or new home flows across multiple tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption copy changes and finish redesigns, with only one test each.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to measured results.
